summary: Iterate: Fix confirmed Steel project-container DNS failure and engine ambiguity. Bandely's container inherited 192.168.88.1 and DNS queries hang, while explicit 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 resolve staging.bandely.com immediately. Provision new project containers with explicit reliable DNS; safely repair existing plugin-owned project containers while preserving their named Chromium profile volume and immutable project binding, with validation and focused tests. Make CLI/UI clearly state that URL-only run uses Playwright and that Jev requires a goal plus explicit --allow-paid; show selected engine and fallback reason prominently. Rebuild/reload, repair Bandely, verify real navigation, commit and push.

state.request: Install and run https://github.com/steel-dev/steel-browser on the dyaus host for use from this BB environment, then create a new independently installable BB plugin in this repository that integrates Steel as the replacement browser infrastructure for the prior KERNEL.SH-based workflow. Keep the root orchestration-only conventions, align manifest/package/CLI/UI/docs/tests, avoid committing generated artifacts, and verify the Steel service plus the plugin's human UI and CLI surface.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Fix the Steel Browser Tools settings panel so it never sends undefined projectId values over RPC. When no BB project context is available, render a clear project-unavailable state instead of calling project RPC, while keeping Jev host configuration visible. Add focused coverage, rebuild, reload, and update the existing draft PR.

sizeDecision.reason: This is a narrow correction to the existing Steel Browser Tools surface and must ship with the same plugin capability; splitting would leave the known settings error unresolved.
